aboutText: With years of experience in Thomastown and surrounding areas, Greenworx provides expert landscape and turf management to commercial and industrial properties. We live by 'The Greenworx Way', emphasizing safety, quality, integrity, and sustainability. Our dedicated team continually innovates to deliver top-notch services, supporting our partners and solving challenges. At Greenworx, our purpose is nurturing our staff, valuing our clients, and safeguarding the environment, now and always.
servicesText: Greenworx offers comprehensive landscape and turf management for commercial and industrial properties. From lawn installation to garden maintenance, we ensure quality and sustainability in every project. Our services are tailored to meet the specific needs of each facility.

services.title: Turf Installation and Repair
services.desc: We specialise in installing and repairing high-quality turf for commercial and industrial sites, ensuring lush, durable lawns.

services.title: Landscape Design and Maintenance
services.desc: Our team designs and maintains beautiful, functional landscapes that enhance property value and aesthetic appeal.

services.title: Commercial Landscaping
services.desc: Tailored landscaping solutions for businesses, focusing on creating professional and inviting outdoor spaces.

services.title: Industrial Turf Management
services.desc: Expert care for large-scale turf areas in industrial settings, promoting sustainability and cost-effectiveness.

services.title: Sustainable Garden Solutions
services.desc: Eco-friendly gardening practices that reduce water usage and support environmental conservation.

services.title: Lawn Care and Mowing
services.desc: Regular lawn care services including mowing, fertilising, and weed control for pristine grass areas.
